annotations.title: Call a provider API via the proxy

description: Send one HTTP request to an AI provider through the local ProphetKey proxy, which injects the real API key for the given safe_key. The agent never sees or transmits the real key. Call prophetkey_list_keys first to get a safe_key. Works with OpenAI-compatible endpoints (e.g. /v1/chat/completions). Consequential: POST/PUT/DELETE can create, update, or delete provider-side resources and may incur cost. Returns the provider response body as text; error cases return an isError result with the reason — 402 when the budget is exceeded, 403 when the safe_key is revoked, unknown, or blocked by a usage window.

body.description: JSON request body. Used for POST and PUT; ignored for GET and DELETE.

endpoint.description: Provider API path starting with '/', e.g. '/v1/chat/completions'. Scheme, host, and port are set by the proxy — do not include them.

method.description: HTTP method: GET to read, POST to create, PUT to update, DELETE to remove.

safe_key.description: safe_key identifier of the vault key to use, obtained from prophetkey_list_keys. The proxy maps it to the real key on-device; passing a real provider key here is rejected.

name: prophetkey_make_request
